home.title: iCoParent
home.subtitle: A calm, private space for two parents and their children.

family.childrenCanPost: Children can post to the family feed
family.childRemoved: Child removed. Their past records are kept.
family.inviteHelp: Send this link. It works once and expires in 7 days.

calendar.tapEvent: Tap an event to acknowledge it or void it.
calendar.quickHint: Right-click a day, or hold it on a phone, for quick actions.
calendar.quickCover: Ask the other parent to cover
calendar.blockerHelp: The other parent can see this time. Children cannot. It does not change who has the children. To ask the other parent to cover them, create a “Can you cover?” agreement.
calendar.title: Title

custody.alternate_weekends: Alternate weekends and a midweek night
custody.proposed: The other parent needs to agree before this pattern changes.

agreements.coverHelp: The other parent is asked to take the children for this time. Nothing changes until they accept.
agreements.counterNeedsNote: Write your counter-offer in the note first.
agreements.waitingHelp: Waiting for the other parent to answer.
agreements.saved: Sent. The other parent has 7 days to answer.
agreements.endsBeforeStarts: The end must be after the start.

help.decision: Ask the other parent to agree on something, like a purchase or a trip.
help.blocker_request: Ask the other parent to take the children for a time you cannot. Nothing changes until they accept.
help.custody_swap: Propose that the other parent has the children for these days. Nothing changes until they accept.
help.event_change: Propose a change to an event the other parent created. They approve it.

money.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than 0, for example 12,50.

feed.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings.

post.created: A new family note was posted.

storage.warning: This family is past 70% of the storage budget.

pwa.ios: On iPhone, use Share, then Add to Home Screen, to receive alerts.
pwa.offline: You are offline. The last opened pages stay available.
